summary.intent: Add 5 new phases to the v1.1 milestone roadmap and kick off Phase 28 (Code Hygiene & Logging) by discussing and capturing implementation decisions via the GSD manager workflow.
summary.outcome: PR #381 created with the updated roadmap, merged to main. Phase 28 CONTEXT.md written with locked decisions: thin custom logger wrapper (not pino), full console.* replacement across 139 calls in 29 files, selective .catch() cleanup for unpin failures only, targeted any-cast fixes in hooks.ts, and deletion of the poc/ directory.

repo: 139 console.* calls across 29 files in apps/web/src/: 82 error, 27 warn, 18 log, 12 time/timeEnd. Biggest offender is hooks.ts with 34 calls leaking Web3Auth SDK state.

11 `.catch(() => {})` calls on unpinFromIpfs spread across bin.service.ts (4), useFileOperations.ts (1), useFileVersions.ts (2), ReplaceFileDialog.tsx (3), useDropUpload.ts (1). Other 3 silent catches (audioContext.close x2, dynamic import) are intentionally silent.
Only 2 of 8 `any` casts are actionable: coreKit and loginParams in hooks.ts. Web3AuthMPCCoreKit type is already exported from core-kit.ts.
00-Preliminary-R&D/poc/ contains 89 MB of committed node_modules and deprecated ipfs-http-client@60.0.1 — safe to delete entirely.
apps/web/src/main.tsx already uses import.meta.env.DEV gating; DEV-only global error capture there should be preserved as-is.
Pino browser redaction does NOT work in browser mode — redact option is Node.js only, making pino unsuitable for a zero-knowledge app that must never leak privateKey/rootFolderKey.

code.finding: File does not yet exist — to be created in Phase 28 as a ~50 LOC thin wrapper with level filtering via VITE_LOG_LEVEL, structured (message, context) arg order, redact() interceptor, and transport hook array for Phase 30 Sentry integration.
34 console.* calls — largest single file. Also contains coreKit: any and loginParams: any which can be typed with Web3AuthMPCCoreKit from core-kit.ts.
Contains DEV-only global error capture using import.meta.env.DEV — keep as-is, not subject to console replacement.

workflow: GSD assumptions mode surfaces codebase evidence before asking the user anything — reduces discussion to ~2-4 corrections vs 15-20 questions.
Todo cross-referencing via gsd-tools can produce false positives on generic keywords (e.g. 'web') — worth scanning the match reasons before folding.
Phase dependency structure: 28 unblocks 29, 30, 31. Phase 32 is independent and can run in parallel with 28.

open_items: console.time/timeEnd calls (12 total) need a decision: replace with logger or exclude from scope.
Phase 30 (Web App Observability) blocked on Phase 28 completing — needs the logger abstraction layer first.
Phase 31 (Structural Decomposition) also blocked on Phase 28.
The any-cast fix for coreKit may be cosmetic if Web3Auth SDK forces any at the boundary — needs verification during implementation.
Phase 30 Sentry integration will wire into the logger.transport hook array created in Phase 28 — design must be compatible.
